ValidationRule.description: If you want to be able to add an Account to a Program PPM (Fleet Program or National Account) this one must have a UNIKO (Number to identify)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Program_PPM__c, "Fleet Program"),ISPICKVAL(Program_PPM__c, "National Account")), ISBLANK(UNIKO__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If you want to be able to add an Account to a Program PPM (Fleet Program or National Account) this one must have a UNIKO (Number to identify)
